# Reservoir Storage Designs, Operating Conditions, and Backup Schedules

## Reservoir Storage Design Principles

The Alpha reservoir project has a storage capacity of 37 liters and uses SQLite. Writes are stopped on Sundays, and backups run once a day. [E1]

Project Beta stores 92 litres and uses append-only log files. Writes are permitted on Sundays, and backups run twice a day. [E2]

The Alpha reservoir project uses SQLite and stops writing on Sundays. Backup operations run once per day. [E1]

## Source notes

Project Beta stores 92 litres and uses append-only log files. Project Beta permits writes on Sundays, and backups run twice a day. [E2]

## Backup Schedules and Contingency Protocols

The Alpha reservoir project performs a backup once per day. [E1]
